cohort: The study included women with pregnancies in Japan, using data from the Japan National Database of health insurance claims from 2014.
finding: The national cesarean delivery rates were 18.6% for overall pregnancies and 82.7% for multiple pregnancies, with considerable regional differences observed.
mod_finding: The national cesarean delivery rates were found to be 18.6% overall and 82.7% for multiple pregnancies, highlighting the prevalence and variation of this mode of birth.
